Congratulations, Hero! \r\n\r\nYou\'ve conquered all currently available main story quests in Titan Quest 2\'s Early Access! Your legend grows, and the gods themselves take notice.

For now, you\'ve been teleported back to the Sanctuary of the Sophoi to rest, regroup, and prepare for what’s to come. The Sickle of Kronos awaits you at the beginning of the next release, and your epic clash with Nemesis is far from over.\r\n\r\nUntil then, keep exploring, uncover secrets, and grow ever stronger. Thank you for playing—and prepare for what\'s to come!
